g.text: United States | full regional profiles, ages 20+
Net migration per 1,000 same-age residents. Rows ordered by 2022 aging share (low to high).
Non-overlapping profile: 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-64, 65+. It excludes ages below 20 and unknown ages; native totals remain in the data.
Both years use one color scale within this country; country scales differ. No extremes clipped. Gray = missing (none in these panels).
Hollow circle = approximate 90% rate interval includes zero; survey covariance omitted.
